{{Quote|It's ''shig''. We grow the ''behot'' for it locally. I find it bracing.|[[Degan Cor]]|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
'''''Behot''''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|herb]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The herb was citrus-flavored and grew rapidly, making it the favored choice of ingredients for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] beverage ''[[shig]]'', a [[Tea/Legends|tisane]] brewed from a number of herbs.<ref name="TMPaC" /> ''Behot'' was mildly antiseptic and stimulating,<ref name="Mando'a" /> and capable of soothing an upset [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]].<ref name="TC" /> ''Shig'' brewed from ''behot'' possessed an amber [[Color/Legends|color]] and the herb's citrus flavor.<ref name="TLJ" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] used ''behot'' herbs in the ''shig'' he brewed for a [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] in order to help settle her stomach.<ref name="TC" /> Mereel's adopted [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Kal Skirata]], also enjoyed a mug of ''behot''-flavored ''shig'' when looking to calm his nerves.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

By the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], members of the anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resistance on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] had taken to growing ''behot'' locally<ref name="TLJ" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> using it to make their own ''shig''. Resistance leader [[Degan Cor]] developed a fondness for ''shig'' brewed from ''behot'', as did several of his rebel colleagues.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Behot'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] novel, [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 30]], [[2007]].<ref name="TC" /> The herb appeared again in Traviss' [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'',<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> and she included details about ''behot'' in her [[Star Wars Insider]] article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]''.<ref name="TMPaC" /> The [[2013]] novel [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]], featured ''behot''-made ''shig'', and noted that the herb was being grown locally on Toprawa in addition to Mandalore.<ref name="TLJ" />
